name: ecommerce-product-research
description: Research products and prices in Claude across Amazon, Walmart, Target, eBay, Google Shopping, TikTok Shop, Lazada and any Shopify store, and find suppliers on AliExpress and Alibaba. Compare one product's price everywhere, check Amazon sellers and Best Sellers, audit a competitor store's catalog, discounts and apps, and estimate sourcing margins. Pay per result on your Apify account.
